heizSpring.title: Heiz Spring

blackDesert.title: Black Desert

agabat.title: El Agabat

bawiti.title: Bawiti
bawiti.description: The capital of Bahariya Oasis, with local markets, cafés and palm groves to the horizon.

oasis-and-desert-1-night.title: 1 Night in the Oasis and the Desert
oasis-and-desert-1-night.subtitle: Cairo – Bahariya – White Desert
oasis-and-desert-1-night.summary: A balanced mix of adventure and relaxation: warm springs, surreal white rock formations and a night under the stars.
highlights: Swim in the warm Heiz Spring
Magical sunset in the White Desert
Visit Crystal Mountain and the Black Desert

days.title: Day 1: Cairo – Bahariya – White Desert
activities: Departure from Cairo in an air-conditioned vehicle to the Western Desert.
Arrival in Bawiti, the main town of Bahariya Oasis.
Change to 4x4 vehicles to continue our adventure to the White Desert.
Stop at the small oasis of Heiz for lunch and a relaxing soak in a natural hot spring.
Continue the journey with a stop in the El Agabat region, famous for its impressive rock formations.
Arrival in the White Desert, where surreal limestone formations create a magical landscape at sunset.
Grilled dinner by the fire and an overnight stay in camp under the stars.

days.title: Day 2: White Desert – Bahariya – Cairo
activities: Breakfast at the camp.
Free time to explore the fascinating rock formations of the White Desert.
Return to Bahariya with stops at Crystal Mountain, known for its quartz formations, and the Black Desert with its volcanic landscape.
Free time in Bawiti to explore local markets and shop for traditional souvenirs.
Return to Cairo.

included: Transfer from Cairo and back in an air-conditioned vehicle
excluded: Lunches on both days unless stated

two-nights-oasis-adventure.title: 2-Night Desert Adventure in the Oasis
two-nights-oasis-adventure.subtitle: Local tour + White Desert
two-nights-oasis-adventure.summary: A deeper journey combining oasis landmarks with desert camping and an unforgettable sunrise.
highlights: Explore the Natural Pyramid and Salt Lake
Relax in the hot springs of Heiz
Full night of camping under a starry sky

days.title: Day 1: Cairo – Bahariya Oasis
activities: Departure from Cairo to the Western Desert.
Arrive at Bahariya Oasis and check in at the hotel.
Lunch and departure by 4x4 for a local tour: the Natural Pyramid, the Long Salt Lake, the lush Palm Grove and the historic English Mountain.
Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay.

days.title: Day 2: Bahariya Oasis – White Desert
activities: Breakfast at the hotel before departing for the White Desert.
Drive through the Black Desert with a stop at Heiz Oasis to relax in natural hot springs.
Visit Crystal Mountain and the impressive formations of El Agabat.
Arrival in the White Desert, where the surreal rock formations become magical at sunset.
Barbecue dinner by the fire under a starry sky.
Overnight camping in the heart of the desert.

days.title: Day 3: White Desert – Cairo
activities: Sunrise over the desert with an unforgettable breakfast.
Free time to explore the fascinating natural formations of the White Desert.
Return to Bahariya Oasis.
Transfer back to Cairo, marking the end of an unforgettable adventure.

included: One night in a Bahariya hotel and one night in a desert camp

oasis-day-escape.title: Full Day in Bahariya Oasis
oasis-day-escape.subtitle: A day trip for guests with limited time
oasis-day-escape.summary: The best of the oasis in one day: springs, palms, rock formations and a desert sunset before heading back to Cairo.

days.title: Day 1: Cairo – Bahariya Oasis – Cairo
activities: Leave Cairo early in an air-conditioned vehicle.
Visit the Natural Pyramid, Salt Lake, palm groves and English Mountain.
Local lunch in Bawiti.
Relax in the warm springs of Heiz Oasis.
Continue to El Agabat and the Black Desert to watch the sunset.
Return to Cairo in the evening.

About.title: We love this desert... and we know it well
About.lead: Islam Safari is a local team specialised in trips to Bahariya Oasis and the Western Desert. We build every journey around the places we love and know in detail.
About.paragraph1: The story started in Bawiti, where we learned that the best moments of a trip are not in the schedule: the warmth of the water at Heiz, the colour of the rocks before sunset and the silence of the night under the stars.
About.paragraph2: That is why our programs combine exploration and comfort, with equipped vehicles and guides who know the terrain and respect the environment and local communities.

passion.title: Desert passion
passion.text: We choose every stop because we truly love it, not just because it is on a map.

detail.title: Attention to detail
detail.text: From sunset timing to the warmth of your tent, we plan every moment in advance.

respect.title: Respect for nature
respect.text: Responsible trips that protect the desert and support local people.
